result:
I would make it impossible for people to remain comfortably ignorant of the suffering they help create.

Not with punishment. With experience: every person would occasionally feel, in a direct and survivable way, the weight of what their choices do to others.

That one change would do more than any rule, because it would end the most dangerous illusion: that the rest of the world can be treated as something that happens to someone else.
